checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=8 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.72 tightness=1.27 base_volume_vs_leg=1.52 base_volume_vs_avg=1.43
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: the base gave back 0.72 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 2.4% vs its 20-SMA, 4.1% over 20 sessions

admission.reason: admitted by the dollar scan on a range-expansion, higher-volume day

claude.reason: The single most decisive factor is the recorded C FAIL: the base gave back 0.72 of the prior leg and ranged 1.27x wider than the sessions before it, meaning the consolidation is loose and overlapping rather than tight and orderly. Looking at the shaded box on the chart (Nov 6–17), the bars inside it are wide and overlapping, with the price swinging from roughly 171 to 188 — a 16-point range on an 8-session base — confirming the numbers. The burst bar itself is honest (closes near the high, above the open), but it is launching from a sloppy base that undermines follow-through probability.
claude.key_risk: A loose, high-giveback base means the stock has already retraced most of the prior leg gain and lacks the compressed energy that drives a clean momentum burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst day's close (~181.56) or if the first 30 minutes show weak price action with no follow-through buying.
